title: Nonlocal Games as Cross-Platform Quantum Benchmarks: Exceeding unconditional classical bounds on trapped-ion processors
summary: Nonlocal games provide application-level benchmarks for quantum hardware whose classical performance bounds are information-theoretic, holding against all classical strategies regardless of computational resources. We implement a 14-vertex graph coloring game, the smallest graph exhibiting a quantum-classical separation for this game type, on four trapped-ion quantum processors across three institutions.
